title: Chapter 541
paragraphs: Chapter 541
Episode 145. Premonition (10)
Within the fortress, the priests and medical teams had their hands full treating the wounded.

Although they had achieved a great victory in the first battle, the fortress had still suffered nearly 2,000 casualties. It was impossible for the healing priests to take care of them all in just two days.
Outside, Amela led the efforts to repair the fortress's defensive equipment.
Her equipment repair speed was nothing short of miraculous. Even with thousands of expert engineers, they could not keep up with her abilities.
However, just like treating the wounded, repairing the equipment in two days was an impossible task.
Dozens of hands formed from magic worked tirelessly since the end of the war, but the recovery was only at 20%.

"Balakas, old man! From now on, I need to focus on improving and deploying the fortress. Since Enya's thermal barrier can't be used, I have to calculate countless variables when we get hit... I also need to find a spot where we can fire at least a couple of times even if we get hit hard... Ah, it's not easy at all!"
She had fought countless wars, but this was the first time she felt so pointless preparing for one.

"Better than doing nothing, but it feels like trying to crack a rock with an egg. If Kelliac is on board, the range of the magic injection type all-weather crusher is beyond the fortress from the start. The result is too humble compared to the effort."
The fortress has to fight with less power than the first battle, while the enemy is gathering the strongest forces of their clan.
In fact, even if Lon was healthy, and even if the Empire didn't betray and fought with Hiran, there was no chance of winning.
The only one in the world who could engage in what could be called a 'fight' against the full-powered enemy was Runecandel.
"Master Swordsman."
Balakas sought Kashimir.
"How do you see it, Master?"
"Do you mean Runecandel?"
Even without any further explanation, Kashimir immediately understood Balakas' meaning.
The Bamul Alliance knew that Runecandel had a camp nearby.
They hadn't seen it directly, but they were confident that their assumptions would not be wrong.

"If the main forces of the enemy have come out, the value of the white stone has been proven, so like the strategist said, they will never stay still. However, Runecandel will hope that the white stone will be destroyed in some way during the war without them having to intervene."
"I think so too. It's a dangerous item that even the master of the mysterious artifact is wary of, so Runecandel will hope it breaks during the war."

"Regardless of the value of that stone, the likelihood of the two clans going to full-scale war is low. It will certainly turn into a negotiation atmosphere... In my opinion, the key issue is not the two major powers, but the strategist's choice."
Whether Runecandel and the enemy go to war or negotiate is up to the strategist.
That's how Kashimir understood the situation.
"If the strategist abandons his friend and Hiran, it will be a negotiation, and if not, it will be a full-scale war... That's what you're saying."
"Yes. And as you know..."
"The Lord would never choose the latter."
"But he is also not the type to be led by emotions and choose the former without any countermeasures."
Both men nodded at the same time.
"Jin is relying on his clan. To be precise, he is using them."
Is he really willing to hold onto the White Stone, even if it means going into an all-out war with Run Kandel?
Can he handle it?
Kashmir thought Jin was pressuring Zhipul with his clan, Run Kandel, as his backing.
That's why, even though their initial plan to rescue Dante and the knights of Hiran and leave the Sword Emperor City failed, he chose to hold on.
Up to now, Jin has solved almost all his difficulties without the help of his clan, using only his own strength and that of his comrades.
It was almost unprecedented for him to utilize the power of Run Kandel, the very origin of his identity, in such a way. And that too, when Rosa was directly in command.

"If Zhipul accepts that pressure and starts an all-out war, Jin will remove all the knights of the Barmel Alliance and Hiran from the battle. From then on, this war becomes not the Sword Emperor City War, but the battle between Run Kandel and Zhipul, and he will exclude all allies other than Run Kandel, even if he has to use the power of his clan."

"That's a very lordly way. I'm sure he'll do as you say, Sword. In case of an all-out war, there could be problems in the process of excluding everyone except Run Kandel, so it seemed like he wanted to send them all out in advance, but those gathered in Hiran wouldn't back down."
"What do you think about the possibility of Rosa overpowering Jin and negotiating with Zhipul?"
That's what Kashmir was most worried about.

The Run Kandel's elite troops, led directly by Rosa, are almost at full strength except for the Black Knights of the previous generation and Shirone. Although the Barmel Alliance now has enough power to rise as the fifth force, it was not enough to protect against Rosa.

"You don't need to worry about that. The Lord is now the closest to being the next head of Run Kandel. There can't be any forceful suppression or punishment of the Lord in front of Zhipul who's watching."
"Then Rosa will ultimately have no choice but to respect Jin's judgment."

"The Lord is also Run Kandel. Although their methods may be different, both Rosa and the Lord share the same goal as Run Kandel. Even if it looks like the Lord is using the clan as a backing and bullying, as long as it does not go beyond the premise of blocking Zhipul's interests, it won't be a fatal problem."
"...I have a feeling that this war may not only decide the fate of Sword Emperor City, but also the fate of the world."
"I feel the same."

"Even if Dante wakes up and we all escape from Sword Emperor City, it's only a delay of the situation. An all-out war, negotiation. One of the two will definitely happen. As long as the White Stone is not destroyed."
The White Stone will be destroyed, and the chaos within it will never wake up.
That would be the only scenario that could end the situation as smoothly as possible, but Talris rated the likelihood of that very low.
"We should focus on backing up the Lord in any situation. The Lord would never give up on his friends, but if that might put him in danger of falling...."
We need to prevent the Lord from falling, even if it means trampling on his feelings.
Balkas added in a somber voice.
That statement carried a lot of implications.
If Jin were to stake his life on not giving up on Hiran, even if the situation worsened to its worst, they would kill everyone in Hiran themselves, even if it meant standing in front of him.
The intention was to make Jin back down.
"The Lord is undoubtedly strong. But that inner strength can sometimes be his weakness. Even though I haven't served the Lord for long, that's how it seems to me."
"I understand what you mean."
"We can only hope that won't happen."
Midnight passed.

Please, let the Sword Emperor wake up and restore the dignity of this land, let Dante escape safely from the seal of chaos, let the enemies arrive just a little bit later, let this dawn, which might be the last, be not so hollow and pitiful.
Time was passing cruelly and swiftly, mocking the many hopes and prayers of those gathered in the Sword Emperor City.
"...Zhipul's main force has been spotted over the Kethu Mountains. It'll arrive at the Sword Emperor City in about three hours."
The knights who had gone out on patrol informed various parts of the castle that the enemies were almost upon them.
"Knight Kashmir."
"Yes, Jin."

"Send the healing priests back to the Holy Kingdom, and order Lord Rutan and my Guardian Knights to return as well. Also, please send back all those with power, including the wounded of the Barmel Alliance, and those under Gilly."

The current official affiliation of the youngest division was Run Kandel, not the Barmel Alliance. Rutan, who commanded them, was an exile, so it was right for him to leave the battlefield before Run Kandel took the lead.
The healing priests had fulfilled their mission.
"Understood."
The name of this war is still the Sword Emperor City War.
That's why Jin was only commanding the Barmel Alliance, but the knights of Hiran considered Jin as their commander.
Jin didn't issue any orders to them. Strictly speaking, the current commander-in-chief of the Hiran army in the Sword Emperor City War was Luyan, the leader of the Five Sword Saints.
But Luyan did not issue any commands to the knights of Hiran either, and she also treated Jin as the commander-in-chief.

There was no need to issue orders because all the knights of Hiran were already in their positions, ready to fight to the death, and honoring Jin as their commander was a show of respect and praise for him, who brought everything he had to Sword Emperor City as soon as the war started.
Before climbing the castle wall, Jin looked at Dante, trapped in the seal, one last time.
"Dante."
The seal of chaos that held Dante was much darker than before.
The color of the white stone, which seemed to be laughing at someone, and the blurry image of Dante were no longer visible.
Jin remained silent for a while with his hand on the seal.
No words would fully convey his feelings, and he was afraid that if his friend heard his troubled voice, it might affect the war within Dante against the chaos.
Instead, Jin stared at his friend for a long time. He showed that he was standing tall, never giving up on him.
It was time.
His colleagues came to Jin's side, informing him that the enemies had arrived.
"See you later."
As Jin climbed the castle wall, the Five Sword Saints and the Dragon Knight Commander, Kalmain, saluted him in silence.
"Sword Saint Luyan, on behalf of Hiran, I express my respect and gratitude to you. It is an honor to fight alongside you."
"Dragon Knight Commander Kalmain Aita, Hiran and this land will never forget that you were our benefactor, even in death."
Jin slowly met their gaze.

"Jin Runkandel, the 12th generation of Runkandel and the commander-in-chief of the Barmel Alliance. I express my infinite gratitude to Hiran for allowing me to fight for my friend, and to those who gathered for Hiran."
Jin raised his eyes and looked at the dark dawn sky behind Luyan and Kalmain.
The fleet of Zhipul, entirely wrapped in the power of flame, was visible, glowing red hot. It looked just like an ominous sun rising.
And in this world, the only person who could protect the entire fleet with such a massive and deep flame and reveal its dignity was...
Only one person.
'Kelliac Zhipul....'
The pinnacle of ruthless and dirty magic.
He had personally led Zhipul to find the Sword Emperor City.
